name: Celebration
description:

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten.

name: Cosmos
description:
From the vision of Paul Pinthon, Maroma’s Art Candles rise as sculpted poetry in wax. Each one-of-a-kind creation — shaped by hand or cast in form — turns light into art, and leftover wax into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space. into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space.

 Cosmos is an artistic tribute to the vastness of the universe. With its rich layers and dimensional form, it evokes the mystery of infinite skies and the beauty of celestial order. A candle of depth and presence, Cosmos brings both light and contemplation, reminding us of the grandeur held in every flicker of flame.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten.

 Longevity : With proper care, your art candle can burn beautifully for months, while retaining its sculptural presence.
shortDescription: The Cosmos Art Candle’s four faces tell tales of stars, galaxies, black holes, white holes, and warps in the spacetime continuum. Immerse yourself in the mysteries of the universe as you bask in the warm, fragrant glow of Cosmos, where physics and art collide in an artful continuum.

name: Effervescence
description:
From the vision of Paul Pinthon, Maroma’s Art Candles rise as sculpted poetry in wax. Each one-of-a-kind creation — shaped by hand or cast in form — turns light into art, and leftover wax into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space. into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space.

 Effervescence   is a crafted expression of vitality and uplift. Its form captures the sparkle of joy and the lightness of spirit, radiating a sense of movement and celebration. Enduring and refined, it burns slowly for months, offering illumination that feels alive with brightness and possibility.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten.

 Longevity : With proper care, your art candle can burn beautifully for months, while retaining its sculptural presence.
shortDescription: Effervescence captures the essence of uncontainable joy. Like a bottle of soda on a warm summer day, it's ready to burst with happiness, radiating an infectious enthusiasm that uplifts any atmosphere. Its effervescent spirit reminds us that sometimes, we need to release our inner fizz and allow our happiness to bubble out of us without limit. With each flicker, Effervescence symbolises the exuberance that sees each moment of life as magical and miraculous. It encourages us to delight in spontaneity and the sheer pleasure of letting our emotions float up and away, like so many soap bubbles in the breeze.

name: Faith
description:
From the hands of Paul Pinthon, Maroma’s Art Candles rise as sculpted poetry in wax. Each one-of-a-kind creation turns light into art, and leftover wax into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space.

 Faith is a sculpted tribute to trust and certainty. Hand-shaped with care, it transforms wax into a form that speaks of hope, devotion, and inner light. Enduring, it burns slowly for months, offering not just illumination but a presence of calm reassurance.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten.

 Longevity : With proper care, your art candle can burn beautifully for months, while retaining its sculptural presence.
shortDescription: Firm in its chiselled, rocklike form, the candle Faith appears to defy the impermanence of its transitory wax medium. It stands resolute, unwavering in its belief in the importance of its message. Finely-crafted, Faith is not just a candle; but a work of art that showcases the enduring nature of belief. Transform your inner and outer world with Faith: add beauty to any space and invite all who behold it to never the question the eternal, the universal the single unifying truth. “You just gotta have faith”.

name: Impact
description:

 Impact resonates with force and intention. Designed to ignite purpose, it turns light into action, reminding us that every choice leaves its mark.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten.

 Longevity : With proper care, your art candle can burn beautifully for months, while retaining its sculptural presence.

name: Patience
description:
From the vision of Paul Pinthon, Maroma’s Art Candles rise as sculpted poetry in wax. Each one-of-a-kind creation — shaped by hand or cast in form — turns light into art, and leftover wax into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space. into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space.

 Patience is a meditation in red and white — a deep crimson form carrying a luminous heart at its center. The boldness of red speaks to passion and vitality, while the pure white heart embodies calm, constancy, and quiet devotion. Together, they express the beauty of waiting with grace. Burning slowly over time, Patience becomes both light and symbol — a reminder that strength often rests in stillness.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten.

 Longevity : With proper care, your art candle can burn beautifully for months, while retaining its sculptural presence.
shortDescription: A pinnacle of the candlemaker’s art, Patience captures the beauty of tension and restraint, waiting for the moment to act. Patience waits, abundant with potential energy. This piece symbolises the anticipation of a moment that may never come, but when it does, the floodgates of opportunity burst open to release all that's been diligently held in abeyance for just that moment. Patience reminds us that sometimes good things come to those who wait.

name: Resilience
description:
From the hands of Paul Pinthon, Maroma’s Art Candles rise as sculpted poetry in wax. Each one-of-a-kind creation turns light into art, and leftover wax into lasting beauty, inviting warmth, elegance, and wonder into your space.

 Resilience is a hand-sculpted statement of strength and grace. Its form embodies endurance and renewal, transforming simple wax into a timeless work of art. Full of presence, it offers months of gentle light while standing as a symbol of beauty that persists. A one-of-a-kind creation, Resilience reflects Paul Pinthon’s vision of turning impermanence into something enduring — a candle that glows with meaning long after the flame.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.

 Wick Size : Keep the wick trimmed to  1/4 inch above the wax surface before every burn for an optimal flame.

 Extinguishing : Suffocate the flame or dip the wick into the melted wax and straighten it.

 Longevity : With proper care, your art candle can burn beautifully for months, while retaining its sculptural presence.
shortDescription: Resilience is a testament to inner strength and stability. Weighing in at a substantial 9.9 kilograms, this candle stands as a symbol of fortitude and endurance. It’s four sturdy walls represent the forces that withstand external pressures to preserve a serene and unwavering inner calm. Its heavy, unyielding core reflects our ability to stay strong in the face of adversity, whether it be the gusts of life's challenges or the powerful forces of emotion, this candle’s light stands as a reminder that human resilience can endure and shine brightly amidst the harshest conditions, for when the walls are firm, the centre remains calm and true in even the most demanding of circumstances.

 Care Instructions

 First Burn : Allow the entire top layer of wax to melt before extinguishing to ensure an even burn.
